clips.title: The story
paras: Hilary is a young human girl living in the lakeside town of Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains. Distraught after dropping a cherished gift from her father into the lake, she spends her time crying along the town's docks.

Amid the mounting threats of gnoll invasions and Blackrock orc warbands pressing down on Lakeshire, the children of the town still face everyday childhood troubles. Hilary accidentally dropped a necklace given to her by her father into the murky waters of Lake Everstill. Terrified that her father will be angry with her, the distraught girl waits by the town pier in tears, hoping someone brave enough will plunge into the lake to retrieve it.
